spec.description: What your UPS reports through docker-nut-upsd: its state, charge, runtime and load now, what needs your attention, and the battery and mains over time. The attention tiles need the rules from alerts/promql.yaml loaded, and Exporter health shows what the exporter could read.

spec.title: Status
spec.description: What the UPS reports now, in words, one box per status word it sets. Green is normal, yellow needs a look, such as running on battery or calibrating, and red needs action now, such as low battery or a battery to replace. No value means upsd has served no fresh status, which UPS data on Exporter health shows.

defaults.noValue: No fresh UPS status. Exporter health shows why.

spec.title: Battery charge
spec.description: The battery charge the UPS reports, with its trend over the selected range. Red below 50% and yellow from 50% to 90% while the battery recharges after an outage, green from 90%. No value means the UPS reports no charge or the data is stale.

spec.title: Runtime left
spec.description: How long the battery would carry the present load, beside the low battery mark, the runtime at which the UPS reports low battery. The gap between the two is the time left before a shutdown starts. No value means the UPS reports no runtime or the data is stale.

spec.title: Load
spec.description: The load on the UPS as a share of its rating, with its trend over the selected range. Green below 70%, yellow from 70% and red from 90%, where a power cut leaves little runtime and an overload can follow. No value means the UPS reports no load or the data is stale.

spec.title: Exporter down
spec.description: Shows while the NutUpsdDown alert fires: no scrape of a nut-upsd exporter has succeeded for 5 minutes, so every other panel is out of date. The tile counts every exporter, because a target that is gone carries no instance. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: On battery
spec.description: Shows while the NutUpsdOnBattery alert fires: the UPS lost mains power and carries the load on battery. Runtime left shows how long it can hold. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Low battery
spec.description: Shows while the NutUpsdLowBattery alert fires: the UPS raised its low battery flag, which on battery starts the shutdown of every machine it protects. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: UPS connection
spec.description: Shows while the NutUpsdCommsLost alert fires: upsd has served no fresh data for 5 minutes, so the UPS state is unknown. Check the cable and UPS data on Exporter health. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Hardware fault
spec.description: Shows while the NutUpsdHardwareFault alert fires: the UPS asks for a new battery, or reports an alarm that the ups.alarm variable names. Plan the service soon. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.expr: sum(ALERTS{alertname="NutUpsdHardwareFault", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance", flag="RB"} * 0 + 1 or ALERTS{alertname="NutUpsdHardwareFault", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance", flag="ALARM"} * 0 + 2)

spec.title: Protection degraded
spec.description: Shows while the NutUpsdProtectionDegraded alert fires: the UPS is calibrating, overloaded or on bypass, and the tile names the most serious. On bypass, a power cut drops the load at once. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.expr: max(ALERTS{alertname="NutUpsdProtectionDegraded", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance", flag="BYPASS"} * 0 + 3 or ALERTS{alertname="NutUpsdProtectionDegraded", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance", flag="OVER"} * 0 + 2 or ALERTS{alertname="NutUpsdProtectionDegraded", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance", flag="CAL"} * 0 + 1)

spec.title: Protection unavailable
spec.description: Shows while the NutUpsdProtectionUnavailable alert fires: the UPS output is off, or the upsmon process that runs the shutdown command has stopped. Restart the container for the second. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.expr: max(ALERTS{alertname="NutUpsdProtectionUnavailable", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance", flag="OFF"} * 0 + 2 or ALERTS{alertname="NutUpsdProtectionUnavailable", alertstate="firing", instance="$instance", flag=""} * 0 + 1)

spec.title: Host poweroff path
spec.description: Shows while the NutUpsdPowerOffPathBroken alert fires: the last D-Bus check found that a forced shutdown could not power off the host. The container log names the cause. Needs the rules from alerts/promql.yaml in a ruler that stores its `ALERTS` series beside the metrics, as Prometheus and Mimir do.

spec.title: Battery charge
spec.description: The battery charge over the selected range, against the low battery mark the UPS reports. A dip is an outage and the climb after it the recharge. A gap means the data was stale or the exporter was not scraped.

spec.title: Runtime left
spec.description: How long the battery would carry the load at each moment of the selected range, against the low battery mark. A runtime that falls while the load holds steady points to an ageing battery. A gap means the data was stale or the exporter was not scraped.

spec.title: Load
spec.description: The load as a share of the UPS rating over the selected range. A yellow dashed line marks 70% and a red one 90%. A gap means the data was stale or the exporter was not scraped.

spec.title: Mains and output voltage
spec.description: The mains voltage reaching the UPS and the voltage it gives the load, over the selected range. Mains that swings while the output holds steady is the UPS correcting it. A missing line means the UPS reports no such reading.

spec.title: On battery
spec.description: When the UPS ran on battery over the selected range, from its status. Each orange band is an outage the UPS carried. A gap means the data was stale or the exporter was not scraped.

spec.title: Scrape
spec.description: Whether the last scrape of this exporter succeeded, the up series your scraper writes for the job nut-upsd. Down means the container is stopped, METRICS_PORT is 0 or the scraper cannot reach port 9199. No value means no scrape in the last few minutes.

spec.title: upsd
spec.description: Whether upsd answered the exporter at the last scrape. Not answering means the NUT server inside the container has stopped, and the container log says why. No value means the exporter was not scraped.

spec.title: UPS data
spec.description: Whether upsd served fresh data for the UPS at the last scrape. Stale means the driver lost the UPS, and the comms watchdog restarts it. No value means the exporter was not scraped.

spec.title: Driver restarts
spec.description: Driver restarts the comms watchdog made, as bars over the selected range. A restart now and then follows a USB reset, while a steady run of them points to a cable, a port or the UPS itself. The counter starts again with each container start.

spec.title: Host poweroff
spec.description: Whether a forced shutdown may power off the host the container runs on, as SHUTDOWN_ON_BATTERY_CRITICAL sets it. Off means a forced shutdown stops only the NUT clients. No value means the exporter was not scraped.

spec.title: Poweroff path
spec.description: Whether the last D-Bus check found that the host could be powered off without a prompt. Broken means a forced shutdown would leave the host running, and the container log names the cause. No value means no check has run, because host poweroff is off or its check interval is 0.

spec.title: upsmon parent
spec.description: Whether the privileged upsmon process, the one that runs the shutdown command, is running. Stopped means a forced shutdown cannot run, and a container restart brings it back. No value means upsmon has not started yet.

spec.title: Last poweroff path check
spec.description: When the D-Bus check of the poweroff path last ran. It runs on the interval the D-Bus check setting gives, so an old time means the checks have stopped. No value means no check has run.

spec.title: NUT UPS

spec.name: instance
spec.label: UPS
spec.description: The docker-nut-upsd exporter to show, by its scrape instance. Each container serves one UPS.

spec.name: attention
spec.label: Attention tiles shown
spec.description: How many Needs attention tiles have data. The row shows only while one does.
